name: End for GTM COMP PRICE

chatHistory.content: Create a single continuous Remotion composition (3840×2160, 25fps, 412 total frames) for an Apify YouTube video b-roll animation about an automated competitor price-monitoring Actor. DESIGN SYSTEM - Background: assets/backgrounds/background_blue.png loaded via staticFile(), rendered as a full-canvas with objectFit "cover" behind every phase - Safe zone: 250px from every edge (usable area 3340×1660 starting at position 250,250). Wrap every phase's content in a SafeZone div with overflow hidden - Font family: 'Inter', sans-serif throughout - Color palette (use these exact values, no new colors): bg #1A1A2E, navy #16213E, blue #00AAFF, green #4ADE80, amber #FBBF24, red #EF4444, muted #9CA3AF, white #FFFFFF card rgba(255,255,255,0.05), cardBorder rgba(255,255,255,0.08) - Motion: spring({ damping: 200 }) for entrances; interpolate() with extrapolateLeft/Right "clamp" for all timed values; stagger sequential elements by 10–15 frames ASSETS - Background: staticFile("assets/backgrounds/background_blue.png") - Closing logo: staticFile("assets/apify/Apify Logo white Wordmark.svg") - All other graphics: inline SVG COMPOSITION STRUCTURE Use TransitionSeries with fade() transitions of 12 frames between phases. Sequence durations include the 12-frame transition overlap. Close with a 20-frame BlackScreen sequence. Sequence layout: - Phase 1: durationInFrames = 90 + 12 = 102 (beat 0–90) - Phase 2: durationInFrames = 49 + 12 = 61 (beat 91–140) - Phase 3: durationInFrames = 89 + 12 = 101 (beat 140–229) - Phase 4: durationInFrames = 121 + 12 = 133 (beat 229–350) - Phase 5: durationInFrames = 42 (beat 356–392, no trailing transition before black) - BlackScreen: durationInFrames = 20 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── PHASE 1 — Nighttime alert (frames 0–90, ~3.6s) Voice: "So the next time a competitor moves at 2 a.m., this catches it." Center the entire dashboard inside the safe zone with the whole composition slightly darkened: overlay a translucent navy rectangle (rgba(22,33,62,0.45)) over the background image during this phase only, fading from 0.6 to 0.4 opacity to sell "nighttime." Build a single large dashboard card (width 2800px, height ~1400px) centered, card style: fill rgba(255,255,255,0.05), border 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08), borderRadius 32px, padding 60px. Inside the dashboard, arrange in a 3-row layout: Row 1 (header strip, top): - Left: a small digital clock display in monospace, font size 64px, weight 800, color white, reading "02:00 AM" — animate the colon to blink (opacity toggle every 12 frames). To the left of the time, a 24px red pulsing dot (red #EF4444, slow sine pulse on opacity 0.4–1.0). - Right: a muted label "COMPETITOR MONITOR — LIVE" in 28px, weight 700, color muted, letter-spacing 0.15em, uppercase. - Fade this header in at frames 0–15 (spring delay 0, damping 200). Row 2 (main content): two columns side-by-side with 60px gap. - Left column (60% width): a competitor product card. Inside: a thumbnail placeholder (rounded square 200×200, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)), beside it a product name skeleton line (width 80%, height 32px, opacity 0.2) and a brand subline (width 40%, height 20px, opacity 0.15). Below those, a large price display: font size 140px, weight 900, color white initially, monospace. Show the price text "$89.99". Spring this card in at frames 5–25. - Right column (40% width): a quiet line-chart area. Render an inline SVG (viewBox 0 0 800 400) showing a flat horizontal line with gentle bumps (5 points roughly at y=200), stroke muted, strokeWidth 4, opacity 0.4. Label below: "Price history — 24h" in 24px, muted. Fade in 5–25. PRICE DROP EVENT at frame 30: - The price text "$89.99" slides up and out (translateY -120px, fades to 0) over frames 30–45 - "$74.99" slides up from below (translateY 120→0, opacity 0→1) over frames 32–47, color shifts to red #EF4444 during entry - A red downward arrow SVG (40×40, strokeWidth 3, strokeLinecap round) appears to the right of the price at frame 45 (spring delay 45) - A "-16.7%" badge appears next to the arrow: red text, font size 56px, weight 800, spring delay 50 ALERT CARD at frame 50: - A red alert notification card slides in from the right edge of the dashboard, settling above and to the right of the price block - Dimensions: width 700px, padding 36×48, fill rgba(239,68,68,0.12), border 2px solid red #EF4444, borderRadius 20px - Contents (in a horizontal row, gap 24px): - A 64×64 warning triangle SVG (stroked red, strokeWidth 3, exclamation inside) - Two stacked text elements: top line "PRICE DROP DETECTED" in 36px weight 900 red uppercase letter-spacing 0.08em, second line "competitor_a · auto-flagged" in 24px weight 600 muted - Animation: spring delay 50, translateX from +200 to 0, opacity 0→1. After landing, a continuous slow red glow pulse on box-shadow (sine wave, period ~30 frames, shadow spread 30–60px at rgba(239,68,68,0.4)) APIFY LISTENING PILL at frame 75: - At the very bottom of the dashboard card, a small status pill centered - Pill: rgba(0,170,255,0.12) fill, 1.5px solid rgba(0,170,255,0.3), borderRadius 40px, padding 14×28 - Contents: a tiny pulsing blue dot (12px circle, sine pulse opacity 0.5–1.0) + text "Apify Actor — listening" in 28px weight 700 blue - Spring delay 75, scale 0.7→1, translateY 20→0 ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── PHASE 2 — Already handled (frames 91–140, ~2s, phase-local frames 0–49) Voice: "You wake up and it's already handled." CRITICAL: Visual continuity with Phase 1. Render the SAME dashboard layout (same dimensions, same row positions for clock, competitor card, chart). The crossfade should feel like a state change, not a new screen. Differences from Phase 1: - Background overlay: the nighttime navy overlay is GONE; background appears at normal brightness immediately. - Clock reads "07:14 AM" — color blue instead of white. The blinking colon continues. - The red alert card from Phase 1 is replaced with a GREEN RESOLVED card in the same position: - Dimensions same as Phase 1's alert card - Fill rgba(74,222,128,0.12), border 2px solid green #4ADE80, borderRadius 20px - Contents: - 64×64 green checkmark SVG (white check inside a green-filled circle) - Top line: "RESOLVED" in 36px weight 900 green uppercase letter-spacing 0.08em - Second line: "Handled at 02:00:14 · while you slept" in 24px weight 600 muted - Animation: spring delay 5 (phase-local), translateY 20→0, opacity 0→1, then a subtle slow green glow (sine pulse on box-shadow, 0–40px spread) - Price block: "$74.99" stays visible but the red color shifts toward muted (animate color from #EF4444 to #9CA3AF over frames 5–20). The down arrow and -16.7% badge fade to 0.4 opacity. A small green tag "monitored" appears next to the price (spring delay 15, pill style with green palette). - Bottom status pill changes: the listening pill morphs into "1 update applied" — fill rgba(74,222,128,0.12), 1.5px solid rgba(74,222,128,0.3), green dot, green text 28px weight 700. Animation: All Phase 2 changes animate in via crossfade + small spring offsets within the first 30 phase-local frames so the resolution reads clearly within the 49-frame beat. ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── PHASE 3 — Three checks (frames 140–229, ~3.5s, phase-local frames 0–89) Voice: "Price adjusted." / "Change logged." / "Team notified." Clean break from the dashboard. Center one large checklist container in the safe zone. Container card: width 2200px, padding 80×100, fill rgba(255,255,255,0.05), border 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08), borderRadius 32px. Spring delay 0, opacity 0→1, translateY 40→0. Inside the container, three rows stacked vertically with 56px gap. Each row is a flex container: - Left side (fills available width): label text in 64px weight 800 white, left-aligned - Right side (fixed width 120px): a circle indicator, 96px diameter Row 1 — "Price adjusted" — checkmark ticks at phase-local frame 0 (absolute 140): - Row fades in immediately at phase start (spring delay 0). - Circle: starts as 96px outlined circle, 4px border rgba(255,255,255,0.2), no fill - At phase-local frame 0, the circle fills with green #4ADE80 (animate fill color over 8 frames), and a white checkmark SVG (strokeWidth 4, strokeLinecap round, viewBox 24×24) draws inside via stroke-dasharray animation over frames 0–14 - Row background flashes: rgba(74,222,128,0.08) at frame 0, animates back to transparent by frame 20 - After the check completes, a thin green underline draws across the bottom of the row (width interpolates 0→100% over frames 14–28, height 2px, green) Row 2 — "Change logged" — same treatment, all timings offset by phase-local frame 26 (absolute frame 166): - Row appears at phase-local frame 26 (spring delay 26) - Check animates at phase-local frames 26–40 - Underline at phase-local frames 40–54 Row 3 — "Team notified" — offset by phase-local frame 49 (absolute frame 189): - Row appears at phase-local frame 49 (spring delay 49) - Check animates at phase-local frames 49–63 - Underline at phase-local frames 63–77 After all three checks (phase-local frame 77 onward), the container border picks up a soft green glow (box-shadow 0 0 40px rgba(74,222,128,0.2), pulses gently via sine on opacity). Below the container, a muted caption at the bottom of the safe zone (margin-top 60px from container): "— Automatic resolution flow —" in 32px weight 500 muted, letter-spacing 0.1em. Fades in at phase-local frame 78 (spring delay 78), translateY 20→0. ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── PHASE 4 — Start your free trial CTA (frames 229–350, ~5s, phase-local frames 0–121) Voice: "If you want to run your first price scrape today, start your free apify from the link below." Center everything vertically in the safe zone. Layout from top to bottom with generous spacing: 1. Headline text 2. Apify wordmark logo 3. CTA button 4. Arrow + caption HEADLINE (phase-local frames 0–31, covers "If you want to run your first price"): - Text: "Run your first price scrape today." - Font: 120px, weight 800, white, center-aligned, letter-spacing 0.02em - Spring delay 0, opacity 0→1, translateY 40→0 APIFY WORDMARK (phase-local frame 31, covers "start your free apify"): - staticFile("assets/apify/Apify Logo white Wordmark.svg") rendered as - Height 180px, objectFit contain, centered horizontally - Margin-top 80px below headline - Spring delay 31, opacity 0→1, scale 0.85→1, translateY 30→0 CTA BUTTON (phase-local frame 50): - Button shape: rounded rectangle, borderRadius 32px, fill blue #00AAFF, no border - Padding: 36px vertical × 120px horizontal - Text inside: "Start free trial" in 88px weight 900 white, letter-spacing 0.02em - Margin-top 80px below logo - Spring delay 50, scale 0.85→1, opacity 0→1, translateY 40→0 - Continuous pulsing glow: box-shadow 0 0 (60 + sin(frame*0.12)*30)px rgba(0,170,255,0.35–0.55), pulse never stops ARROW + CAPTION (phase-local frame 75, covers "from the link below"): - Below the button (margin-top 60px), a downward arrow SVG - Arrow: 80px wide × 120px tall, stroke blue #00AAFF, strokeWidth 6, strokeLinecap round, viewBox sized so head points DOWN. Shape: vertical line + chevron at the bottom. - The arrow draws itself via stroke-dasharray animation over phase-local frames 75–95 - After drawing completes, the arrow translates vertically in a continuous bob: translateY interpolated as sin((frame - 95) * 0.12) * 12px - Below the arrow (margin-top 24px), caption text: "Link in description" in 44px weight 600 muted, center-aligned - Caption fades in at phase-local frame 90 (spring delay 90) ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── PHASE 5 — Actor ready (frames 356–392, ~1.5s, phase-local frames 0–36) Voice: "The actor is ready to go." Visual continuity with Phase 4 — keep the Apify wordmark, button, arrow, and caption in the same positions. The CHANGE in this phase: REPLACE HEADLINE: - The "Run your first price scrape today." headline shrinks out (scale 1→0.9, opacity 1→0) over phase-local frames 0–10 - A green status pill takes its place (spring delay 8): - Pill: rounded 999px, fill rgba(74,222,128,0.12), 2px solid green #4ADE80 - Padding: 24px vertical × 60px horizontal - Contents (horizontal row, gap 24px): - A 32px green dot (#4ADE80), continuous sine pulse on opacity 0.5–1.0 - Text "ACTOR READY" in 64px weight 900 green, letter-spacing 0.15em, uppercase - Animation: scale 0.85→1, opacity 0→1, translateY 20→0 The Apify wordmark scales up subtly during this phase: scale interpolates from 1.0 to 1.05 over phase-local frames 0–24, then holds. CTA button and arrow continue their pulse/bob loops uninterrupted from Phase 4 (do not reset their animations on phase change). ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── TRANSITIONS Use TransitionSeries with fade() and linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 12 }) between every phase. No transition between Phase 5 and the closing BlackScreen — let Phase 5 hold then cut to a 20-frame black tail. CRITICAL CONTINUITY NOTES - Phase 1 → Phase 2: the dashboard layout must be IDENTICAL. The crossfade should make it feel like the same screen changing state, not a new scene. Use the same coordinates and sizes for the clock, competitor card, chart, alert card, and status pill across both phases. - Phase 4 → Phase 5: the wordmark, button, and arrow must be in IDENTICAL positions. Only the headline → green pill swap is new content. USE - AbsoluteFill, useCurrentFrame, useVideoConfig, spring, interpolate, Img, staticFile from "remotion" - TransitionSeries, linearTiming from "@remotion/transitions" - fade from "@remotion/transitions/fade" EXPORT a default MainComposition component.

Apply the following edits to the existing Remotion composition. Do not regenerate from scratch — modify the existing structure surgically.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EDIT 1 — COMPOSITION STRUCTURE: trim to 3 phases, no openers/closers

In the MainComposition TransitionSeries:
- DELETE the entire Phase 4 sequence and its preceding TransitionSeries.Transition
- DELETE the entire Phase 5 sequence and its preceding TransitionSeries.Transition
- DELETE the closing BlackScreen sequence
- DELETE any opening BlackScreen sequence (if present). Start the composition directly on Phase 1, no fade-in from black.
- Delete the Phase4 and Phase5 component definitions entirely. Delete the BlackScreen component if it has no other use.

Final sequence:
- Phase 1 sequence: durationInFrames = 90 + 12 = 102
- fade transition: 12 frames
- Phase 2 sequence: durationInFrames = 50 + 12 = 62
- fade transition: 12 frames
- Phase 3 sequence: durationInFrames = 90 (no trailing transition — Phase 3 is the last phase and ends hard at its final content frame, no fade-out)

Total composition durationInFrames = 90 + 12 + 50 + 12 + 90 = 254 frames. Update the root composition duration accordingly.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EDIT 2 — REBUILD PHASE 1: tight card, minimal content, no wasted space

Replace the entire Phase 1 layout. The new Phase 1 contains ONLY these elements:

(a) A "02:00 AM" timestamp floating above the product card — small, not a full header strip
(b) A TIGHT product card sized exactly to its contents (no big empty container)
(c) A "PRICE DROP DETECTED" red badge that appears beside/above the card after the price flip

Remove entirely from Phase 1:
- The "COMPETITOR MONITOR — LIVE" label
- The line chart and "Price history — 24h" caption
- The product name skeleton lines
- The brand subline skeleton
- The full-width dashboard container card
- The "Apify Actor — listening" status pill
- The "competitor_a · auto-flagged" subline inside the alert badge
- The nighttime navy overlay over the background

NEW Phase 1 layout, centered in the safe zone:

TIMESTAMP (top of stack):
- Text "02:00 AM" in monospace, 72px, weight 800, white. Blinking colon (opacity toggle every 12 frames).
- A 20px red pulsing dot (#EF4444, sine pulse on opacity 0.4–1.0) to the LEFT of the time, 24px gap.
- This timestamp block is horizontally centered, sitting 80px ABOVE the product card.
- Spring delay 0, opacity 0→1, translateY -20→0.

PRODUCT CARD (center, TIGHT):
- The card width is determined by its contents — do NOT set a fixed width. Use display: inline-flex or fit-content sizing so the card hugs the inner content exactly.
- Padding: 56px on all sides (no more).
- Fill: rgba(255,255,255,0.05). Border: 2px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.08). BorderRadius: 28px.
- Inner layout: horizontal flex row, gap 56px, align center.
  - LEFT: product mockup graphic — a 280×280 rounded square (borderRadius 20px) filled with rgba(255,255,255,0.08). Inside, render a simple inline SVG silhouette suggesting a generic product (e.g. a stylized box/package outline: viewBox 24×24, stroke white at 0.4 opacity, strokeWidth 1.5, a 3D box shape — top diamond + two side panels). The SVG is 140px wide, centered in the square.
  - RIGHT: a vertical flex column, gap 16px, align flex-start.
    - PRICE: text rendered as a single horizontal element. Starts as "$89.99" in 180px, weight 900, color white, monospace, letter-spacing -0.02em.
    - Below the price, a horizontal row with 20px gap: a red downward arrow SVG (48×48, stroke #EF4444, strokeWidth 4, strokeLinecap round, simple arrow pointing down) + the text "-16.7%" in 72px, weight 800, color #EF4444.
- Card spring entrance: delay 5, scale 0.92→1, opacity 0→1, translateY 30→0.
- The arrow + percentage row is HIDDEN initially (opacity 0). It only appears after the price flip event (see below).

PRICE FLIP EVENT at frame 30:
- The price text "$89.99" slides up and out: translateY 0→-100 and opacity 1→0 over frames 30–45.
- "$74.99" slides up from below into the same position: translateY 100→0, opacity 0→1, color animates from white to #EF4444 over frames 32–47.
- The arrow + "-16.7%" row fades in at frame 45 (spring delay 45, opacity 0→1, translateY 20→0).

PRICE DROP ALERT BADGE at frame 55:
- A compact red badge appears OUTSIDE the product card, positioned to its TOP-RIGHT (absolute position relative to the card group, with translate offset so it sits in the corner with a slight overlap onto the card border, like a tag).
- Badge contents: a 40×40 warning triangle SVG (stroked #EF4444 with white exclamation) + text "PRICE DROP DETECTED" in 32px, weight 900, color #EF4444, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.08em. Horizontal layout, gap 16px.
- Badge padding 20×32, fill rgba(239,68,68,0.12), border 2px solid #EF4444, borderRadius 16px.
- Spring entrance: delay 55, scale 0.8→1, opacity 0→1, translateX 40→0.
- After landing, continuous red glow pulse on box-shadow: spread oscillates 30→60px at rgba(239,68,68,0.4), sine period ~30 frames.

There is no other content in Phase 1. The composition feels minimal, tight, and focused entirely on the product + price drop + alert.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EDIT 3 — UPDATE PHASE 2: mirror the new Phase 1 layout exactly

Phase 2 must remain visually continuous with the new Phase 1. The same elements appear in the same positions, only the STATE changes.

Mirror the new Phase 1 layout (timestamp + tight product card + corner badge), with these state differences:

TIMESTAMP:
- Text changes to "07:14 AM"
- Color shifts from white to blue #00AAFF (animate via crossfade across the phase transition)
- The pulsing dot color shifts from red to green #4ADE80
- Blinking colon continues

PRODUCT CARD (identical position, dimensions, and inner layout to Phase 1's card):
- Product mockup graphic: unchanged
- Price "$74.99": color animates from red #EF4444 to muted #9CA3AF over phase-local frames 0–20
- Arrow + "-16.7%": fade to 0.4 opacity over phase-local frames 0–20

CORNER BADGE (same position as Phase 1's alert badge):
- The badge swaps content: from "PRICE DROP DETECTED" to "RESOLVED"
- Fill rgba(74,222,128,0.12), border 2px solid green #4ADE80
- Icon: 40×40 green checkmark SVG (white check inside a filled green circle), replacing the warning triangle
- Text "RESOLVED" in 32px, weight 900, color #4ADE80, uppercase, letter-spacing 0.08em
- Continuous green glow pulse on box-shadow: spread 20→40px at rgba(74,222,128,0.35)
- Use the transition crossfade between Phase 1 and Phase 2 to morph between the red and green states.

Remove from Phase 2:
- The "1 update applied" bottom pill
- The "monitored" green tag next to the price
- The "Handled at 02:00:14 · while you slept" subline

Phase 2 has no other content. The viewer sees the same scene as Phase 1, now resolved.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
EDIT 4 — PHASE 3: unchanged

Leave Phase 3 exactly as currently implemented. Same checklist, same timing, same three rows ticking at phase-local frames 0, 26, 49. Same caption at phase-local frame 78.

────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
DO NOT
- Do not add any closing BlackScreen, fade-out, or hold frames after Phase 3.
- Do not add any opening BlackScreen or fade-in before Phase 1.
- Do not introduce new colors, new fonts, or new asset references.
- Do not modify Phase 3 in any way.
